packageRules.description: Upgrade the Vite+ toolchain with `vp upgrade` and `vp migrate`, because these versions must move together
typedoc 0.28 supports TypeScript <= 6.0. Keep the pnpm catalog (the packages) on TypeScript 6 until typedoc supports 7

Nitro v3 puts the date in the patch of its prerelease versions (`3.0.261029-rc`), and Renovate updates a prerelease only within the same patch by default. Follow the `latest` tag of Nitro in the pnpm catalog only, so that Renovate keeps the peer dependency range of @intlify/nitro as is
